lines.arrive: A shared pasture. Anyone may graze their sheep here.
lines.herders: Five neighbours, two sheep each. The grass is thick.
lines.add_1: One more sheep. A little more for you. The grass belongs to everyone.
lines.follow: Your neighbours notice. They add sheep too.
lines.ask: Each extra sheep helps its owner, but the cost is shared by all. So why would anyone stop?
lines.bell: You ring the bell. The neighbours gather.
lines.agree: Together, you agree on limits. Nobody owns the grass, but everyone looks after it.
lines.collapse: The grass is gone. For everyone.
lines.sheep: This one's yours. She has no idea about any of this.
